key_reasoning.reason: New resolver module (claude.models.ts: catalog fetch, tier-aware ranking, TTL cache, fallback logic) plus coordinated changes to claude.plugin.ts (beforeRun wiring) and anthropic-subscription.template.ts (blanking model tiers so this provider stays untouched) — 3 substantive components spanning the Agent-Tool and External/Provider layers, with a genuinely new abstraction (live model resolution) not present before.

No exact precedent for auto-resolving Claude model tiers from a live catalog on every session start; adds a network round-trip to the beforeRun hot path (mitigated by a 5-minute TTL cache and per-tier try/catch isolation). Silent model-tier auto-switch behavior is a behavior-affecting change, though it is deliberately conservative (never overrides a still-valid explicit selection, falls back to static recommendedModels on catalog failure).
